documented_events.text: The Bootleg Fire burned through nearly 100,000 acres of the project.
Wildfire losses put live carbon below baseline, triggering termination and retirement of at least 1.14 million credits from California's buffer pool.
The owner sought to re-list 87% of the same land as four new projects (ACR1025-ACR1028).

credit_batch.issued_note: At least 1.14 million credits were issued (CarbonPlan, 2023). The 2015-2020 vintage range is illustrative.
credit_batch.monitoring_months_note: Snow-free season at ~1,500 m in the eastern Cascades.
